questions.q: Proofread the mock Section C paragraph on the pupil PDF; fix every error.
questions.a: Splices, homophones, apostrophes and paragraphing corrected.

questions.q: Write your top three errors into your error log with the rule.

Core: in the portal response box, write your personal revision plan to 24 May (one line a week) and one Section C five-line plan for 'Describe a market as it closes for the night.' Starter: 'Week of 15 Mar: ...'
questions.a: A dated weekly plan linked to repairs, and a controlled five-line plan.

questions.q: Extend: add one daily ten-minute habit (e.g. spelling or a reading article).
Stretch: write your Section C opening sentence.
Section C was unfinished. The most likely fix is...
options: Plan in five lines and keep the story small
questions.a: C) Plan in five lines and keep the story small. Unfinished pieces usually come from over-large plots and no plan.

questions.q: Proofreading time in Section C is about...
Answer the ponder in one sentence.
questions.a: Usually no plan and a story too big for the time.
